diagnostic_boundaries.train_pairing: Keep record identities,terminal,mu,logsigma,noise instance and g aligned; no posthoc nearest-neighbor truth for independent generated samples.
diagnostic_boundaries.shuffle: Within-terminal independent column permutations of fixed same-n decoder Z preserve each empirical coordinate marginal while perturbing joint structure; whole-row permutation does not.
shuffle_limits: finite random permutations do not guarantee all dependence vanishes
shuffling parameter r does not generally preserve resulting z marginals
diagnostic_boundaries.native_prior: Sample standard normal zp then inverse conditional flow with specified available g; train-g-conditioned diagnostic is not c-only independent generation.
diagnostic_boundaries.standard_normal_decoder_control: z~N(0,I) directly in decoder coordinates is separately named control,not native conditional prior.
diagnostic_boundaries.same_n_reference: Require matched n,terminal,coordinates and predeclared indexing/sampling contract before interpreting high-dimensional distances or proposing whitening/W2 claims.
diagnostic_boundaries.fair_AR: Direct-z methods still need equal information and fair budget/selection opportunity against full AR.
